statement.label: 02 — The Cave
body_parts: Some men come in every three weeks. Some come in once, on holiday, and then plan the rest of their trip around the next appointment. Either way the room is the same:
low light, a good chair, a barber who asks what you actually want
before anything is switched on. We do cuts, beards and shaves in La Cala de Mijas.

experience.label: 04 — The Experience

pillars.p: We ask first. Your hair, your head shape, how you wear it on a Tuesday morning. Then we start.
Clippers, scissors and a straight razor, used in the order the cut requires. Fades taken down clean, lines set square.
Hot towel, product chosen for your hair rather than for the shelf, and a finish you can repeat at home.
Low light, red leather, and no rush. Booked time is your time.

about_page.h1: The Cave, La Cala de Mijas
about_page.p1: The Cave is the men's barbershop on Av. Las Gardenias, inside the London and Co. premises. You come here for cuts, beard design, traditional shaves and grooming.
about_page.p2: The room is hard to mistake: a hexagonal LED ceiling, deep red chairs, black capes with the wordmark. Two barbers take bookings by name, Gabriel and Ygor. You choose your barber when you book.
about_page.p3: Most of our clients live between Mijas Costa and Marbella. Plenty are here on holiday and book before their flight home.
about_page.attributes_intro: The Google listing shows the shop as LGBTQ+ friendly and women-owned.

careers_page.p1: We hire barbers who care about the finish more than the clock. If that sounds like you, introduce yourself.
careers_page.p2: Send a few lines about yourself and where we can see your work. We reply to everyone.

sections.p: This site belongs to The Cave, a barbershop operating within London and Co., Av. Las Gardenias 9, local 1, Jardín Botánico, Mijas Costa, Málaga 29649, Spain. Contact: thelondonandco@gmail.com.

Nothing. This site has no analytics, no tracking pixels, no marketing tags and no forms that send data to us or to third parties. The careers page composes an email in your own email app; nothing is stored or transmitted by this site.
The company hosting this website may keep standard technical access logs, such as IP address and time of request, for security. We do not use them to identify you.

sections.h: External services you may choose to open
sections.p: Booking runs on Shortcuts Software, an external system with its own privacy policy. Links to WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and Google Maps take you to those services, which process data under their own policies. Nothing loads from them until you click.
Under the GDPR you can ask us what personal data we hold about you and ask for its correction or deletion. Write to thelondonandco@gmail.com.
This website sets no cookies. None. That is why there is no cookie banner.
No analytics, no embedded social feeds, no chat widgets and no advertising tags load on this site.
The booking system, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and Google Maps are external services. Once you open them, their own cookie policies apply.
If we ever add a service that needs cookies, this page and a consent banner will appear first. Consent will be a real choice, with reject as easy as accept.
